criteria.requirement: Add SortedKeyList.refresh_at(index) with Python index protocol/negative indexes. A caller explicitly changed one payload key: remove by STORED index (never search with new key), rebuild a candidate index and reinsert at current key, then atomically commit only if all comparisons/key evaluations succeed. Return original payload identity. Other payload keys are required stable; a failed refresh preserves original stored ordering/key caches, without claiming rollback of caller object changes or key callback side effects. Maintain original key-stability default contract.
